name: scripts
//: The repository's scripts: the build every release artifact comes from, the publication, the CI guard, the registry probe and the gate's helpers. scripts/tests drives the probe and publish.sh against local registries, behind this project's own edge; onebudgetspec-packaging-e2e builds every artifact through build-dist.sh, and repo-checks drives the CI guard.

commands: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check --quiet --config scripts/ruff.toml scripts/release-probe.py scripts/tests

options.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --check --config scripts/ruff.toml scripts/release-probe.py scripts/tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --config scripts/ruff.toml scripts/release-probe.py scripts/tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ty check --quiet --error-on-warning --python-version 3.12 scripts/release-probe.py scripts/tests
